title: Candy Oven
about: Building a candy-producing stage prop that became the beginning of lasting friendships.
description: This track remembers building the candy oven with Lauren and Will. We started by building a wooden shelf that served as part of the set, then designed it so that in the middle of the show it could flip up and transform into a candy oven. Lights, fans, wiring, screws, and a hidden crew helped bring the effect to life, while Paul and Shawn checked in as the project came together. During the show, the shelf would flip into the oven and candy would pour through on cue. The song refers to it as a 'metal shelf,' even though the actual shelf was built from wood. 'Metal' worked better with the rhythm and wording of the song, so I kept it as a small creative liberty rather than sacrificing how the story flowed. What lasted longest, though, wasn't the prop itself, but the friendships that grew while we built it.
lyrics: Boards and screws spread on the floor,
Paul and Shawn would walk on by,
Piece by piece we shaped the frame,
By week's end it had a name.
Out of wood and borrowed dreams.
Flip the front and hide the crew,
When the music hit its cue,
Three of us with different parts,
Building more than props and arts.
I ran lights and powered fans,
Helping bring the show to play.
Out of wood and borrowed dreams.
Flip the front and hide the crew,
When the music hit its cue,
Can become what life still fills.
Not just lumber, screws, and paint,
Some things time can never taint.
Sometimes they start with building things.
It had changed the three of us quietly.
Years have passed, we're still around,
